# Dispatch B acceptance scenarios

1. Bind a host world task, request trees, apply it, then request flowers. Current requirements and machine revisions must refresh; historical tree instructions must not replay.
2. Large Chinese messages, complete tool definitions and images must enter preflight. Switch to a smaller configured model: fail or compact within that window, never silently substitute a model.
3. Force three compactions through PI's real compact implementation. Preserve the transcript, current correction, resource references and durable ledger. Provider-fixture validation is separate from a native real-model green finish.
4. Stop during a provider that ignores abort. Return cancelled; late success cannot execute tools. Failed ledger settlement cannot release terminal tool calls.
5. Execute generic Read/Write/Edit/Bash directly for a world task: reject in runtime and independently in host. Ordinary PI sessions retain their existing behavior.
6. Review an oversized scene: include all changed code and dependencies with hashes and omitted object anchors. Global geometry claims remain unverified; oversized complete slices fail explicitly.
7. Complete a normal main turn while review is pending. Review may continue for its exact current verification without any write lease. Stop, cancellation or a newer turn revokes it.

Run only independent headless/offscreen or pure logic tests. No mouse, keyboard, focus, visible window or Pointer Lock is allowed.
